assessment: This study uses a tour de force of biosensor constructs providing evidence that dopamine transport by OCT2 across the plasma membrane and also (presumably) into the Golgi activates GPCR signaling at the Golgi, leading to cAMP production and PKA activation. Thus, intracellularly compartmentalized signaling underlies aspects of dopamine D1 receptor signaling. The work will be of interest to scientists working on the biology of dopamine signaling.
